messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync — we need to lock the GPU procurement plan for Q1 2028. decision: % reserve vs spot for prod-critical vs best-effort workloads. goal is to hit 95% p95 latency SLOs and keep cost delta within 18% of current run rate. any major objections?
Ryan (Eng-Infra): +1 we should split by workload class. suggested starting point: 60% reserved (steady state), 30% spot (burst), 10% short-term temporary on-demand for spikes.
Tom (Eng-SRE): want to call out cold cache penalties on spot preemptions — for LLM workloads a preempt can add ~300-500ms p95 depending on KV cache hit rates. need fallback policy.
Sophia (Finance): rough numbers — reserved commit for 200 A100-ish GPUs = ~$120k/mo commit, effective hourly ~$0.4/hr/GPU. spot avg last 30d ~$0.22-$0.35/hr but volatile. projection: if we move 30% of sustained to spot we save ~18-25% with higher variance.
Ana (Ops): ops note: cross-region latency matters. If we push spot-heavy to APAC, preemption frequency is ~2x per month right now. we should avoid putting low-latency customer tiers on spot in non-primary regions.
Ryan (Eng-Infra): agree. proposal: classify pools: "critical" (reserved + reserved burst), "balanced" (hybrid), "best-effort" (spot heavy). map models: r-infer-small => best-effort, r-infer-mid => balanced, r-infer-large-prod => critical.
Maya (PM): can we get concrete throughput targets per pool? need to translate to GPU counts for procurement. deadline for procurement request is next Fri EOD.
Tom (Eng-SRE): p95 latency target per pool: critical <= 120ms, balanced <= 220ms, best-effort <= 350ms. translate to concurrency targets: critical 10k tokens/s aggregate, balanced 6k, best-effort 2k.
Ryan (Eng-Infra): doing a quick calc — with current model mixes and batching, critical needs ~220 GPUs reserved; balanced ~140 GPUs mix, best-effort ~40 GPUs (mostly spot). rounding up +15% buffer => reserve request = 260 GPUs.
Sophia (Finance): that reserve number pushes commit to ~$156k/mo. if we keep balanced pool partly spot (50/50) we can drop commit to ~$120k/mo. tradeoff: more ops complexity.
Ana (Ops): ops checklist: 1) ensure preemption fast-fail fallback routing 2) warm cache on canary nodes 3) monitoring alert for preemption spike 4) region affinity config. we need these before any spot ramp.
ProcureBot: procurement ticket created: PR-5421, requested GPUs: 260, requestor: Maya, target delivery window: 2028-01-05..2028-01-20.
Maya (PM): nice. two open questions: (A) do we accept Sophia's contingency to reduce reserve to 200 and rely on spot for balanced? (B) what's the operational cost of the hybrid (oncall noise + manual reconciliation)?
Tom (Eng-SRE): Ops estimate: hybrid adds ~0.5 FTE of oncall overhead during peak procurement months (triage + routing fixes). automation can reduce that after 2 sprints.
Ryan (Eng-Infra): automation plan: implement preempt-aware scheduler + fast KV cache restore. rough delivery: 3 sprints to MLP. reduces ops overhead to ~0.1 FTE.
Sophia (Finance): if we accept automation roadmap, we can commit to 220 reserved now (saves 11% vs earlier) and use spot to fill bursts. that keeps monthly commit ~ $132k.
Maya (PM): decision proposal: commit to 220 reserved GPUs (priority: NA+EU primary zones), keep balanced pool 50% spot until MLP automation is green, re-evaluate after 60 days. does that get thumbs? :thinking:
Ryan (Eng-Infra): :thumbsup: from infra — will draft procurement spec with region breakdown (NA 140, EU 60, APAC 20) and requested delivery windows.
Tom (Eng-SRE): :thumbsup: on condition we get an automation ticket and preemption runbook before we ramp spot >35%.
Sophia (Finance): :thumbsup: I can sign off on 220 commit with the 60-day re-eval clause. please add a cost cliff trigger (if spot spend variance > +/-12% trigger review).
Ana (Ops): noted — will add runbook items and a preemption dashboard. can we get a canary plan for warm caches?
Ryan (Eng-Infra): canary plan: spin up 8 reserved + 8 spot in NA, route 5% traffic for 48h, check p95, KV restore <200ms. adding ticket.
Maya (PM): awesome. action items: Ryan create procurement PR (assign to ProcureBot) by Tue, Tom create automation ticket and runbook, Ana build preemption dashboard, Sophia add cost trigger thresholds to billing alerts. decision locked unless anyone raises major blocker by Mon EOD. thanks all. :rocket:
